MARA.delivery: dry, guarded, older than she looks

ELI.delivery: eager, a little too loud for the room

NARRATOR.delivery: warm, unhurried, a storyteller by a fire

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The storm had been circling the island for three days when the boy finally climbed the stairs. Mara heard him long before she saw him: every step on the iron spiral rang like a struck bell.
segments.display:
The storm had been circling the island for three days when the boy finally
climbed the stairs. Mara heard him long before she saw him: every step on the
iron spiral rang like a struck bell.

segments.speaker: ELI
segments.text: Are you the keeper? They said in the village you'd be up here.
segments.display: Are you the keeper? They said in the village you'd be up here.

segments.speaker: MARA
segments.text: They say a lot of things in the village. Shut the hatch. You're letting the weather in.
segments.display:
They say a lot of things in the village. Shut the hatch. You're
letting the weather in.

segments.speaker: ELI
segments.text: Sorry. Sorry. It's just, I've been climbing for ages. How many steps is it?
segments.display:
Sorry. Sorry. It's just, I've been climbing for ages.
How many steps is it?

segments.speaker: MARA
segments.text: Two hundred and twelve. You'll count them yourself on the way down.
segments.display: Two hundred and twelve. You'll count them yourself on the way down.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: She turned back to the great lens, polishing a brass fitting that was already spotless. The boy hovered at the edge of the light.
segments.display:
She turned back to the great lens, polishing a brass fitting that was already
spotless. The boy hovered at the edge of the light.

segments.speaker: ELI
segments.text: My mother says you keep a log. Every ship, every night, for forty years. She says—
segments.display:
My mother says you keep a log. Every ship, every night, for forty years.
She says—

segments.speaker: ELI
segments.text: She's sick. That's why I came.
segments.display: She's sick. That's why I came.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: For a long moment the only sound was the rain against the glass, and the slow grinding turn of the lamp.
segments.display:
For a long moment the only sound was the rain against the glass, and the slow
grinding turn of the lamp.

segments.speaker: ELI
segments.text: The Wren. Nineteen years ago. It never came back.
segments.display: The *Wren*. Nineteen years ago. It never came back.

segments.speaker: MARA
segments.text: I know the night. I wrote it down.
segments.display: I know the night. I wrote it down.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: She set the cloth aside, crossed to the shelf, and pulled down a book whose spine had split along its length.
segments.display:
She set the cloth aside, crossed to the shelf, and pulled down a book whose
spine had split along its length.

segments.speaker: MARA
segments.text: Sit. If you want the truth, you'll have to hear all of it. And you won't like the ending.
segments.display:
Sit. If you want the truth, you'll have to hear all of it. And you
won't like the ending.

segments.speaker: ELI
segments.text: I didn't come up here to like it.
segments.display: I didn't come up here to like it.
